Flein the Baldie

Biography

Flein the Baldie is a thief from the abandoned-mines district. He admits killing the investigator and planting a Woodsfolk arrow to shift the blame. Rather than steal from the Woodsfolk, he took an arrow from the governor’s collection, helped by a cloaked employer who knew how to bypass the magical traps. His testimony links the theft, murder and search for the Princess. [1, 2]
